source_definition: The source is a connected bipartite graph of radius at most four. Its outputs are nontrivial cuts with crossing degree at most one, or NO-SOLUTION.
target_definition: Both problems ask for a nontrivial vertex bipartition with at most one opposite neighbor per vertex, or NO-SOLUTION. Inputs are connected bipartite graphs, with radius at most four in the source and at most three in the target.
required_result: Construct deterministic polynomial-time maps F and G: F sends every legal source instance to a legal target instance, and G(x,y) is a valid source output for every valid output y of F(x). Preserve the stated threshold, domain and promises. The requested complexity conclusion is NP-hardness for the stated target problem.
